name: mod-manager
description: A Dracula-themed pane to install the claude-mods and turn them on and off. Every other mod ships disabled; this one is on and lists them all.

showChip.title: Show the Mods chip
showChip.description: Show the ⚙ Mods chip above the prompt. /mods opens the pane either way.

claudePath.title: claude path
claudePath.description: Full path to the claude CLI, used by the Install buttons when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.
